cards.how_to_apply: By script (the route PGD used for the thumbnail): load <Photoshop 2026 install folder>/Required/Legacy Shapes and More.csh as custom shapes, then Action Manager make on a contentLayer whose shape is a customShape descriptor with this name, this ID ('6fc26100-4897-11d6-be2a-a851f179e150': the .csh file stores it as $6fc26100-4897-11d6-be2a-a851f179e150, the PGD renderer passes it without the $) and Top/Left/Btom/Rght pixel bounds plus a solidColorLayer fill; the library must be loaded first. In the interface the Custom Shape tool (U, Shift+U cycles the shape tools) should list it in the shape picker (options bar) or Shapes panel under the group path 'Legacy Shapes and More/All Legacy Default Shapes/Banners and Awards' as stored in the .csh file; PGD did not drive the picker, so those clicks are inferred, not observed. Drag on the canvas (Shift keeps proportions) and set Fill / Stroke in the options bar.
cards.notes: PGD thumbnail: applied in Photoshop as a custom shape layer (by name and ID), filled near-black on white and fitted to the shape's own aspect ratio. Shapes are single-colour paths: white areas inside the black are holes (cut-outs) in the path, not white paint. Pixel check of the 320 px thumbnail: no fully enclosed white holes; white inside the outline, where present, is open to the outside (a cut channel or gap).

verified.note: Rosette with about 26 small points on its round badge (radius profile) and two V-notched tails.
